title: Culture Round: AI Safety, Values and Judgment
summary: A 55-minute onsite conversation about AI-safety judgment: why Anthropic and why safety matters to you, a chain of hypothetical dilemmas pressed with follow-ups, a critical read of the company's own published safety commitments, personal stories about being persuaded, repairing a relationship, and owning a mistake, and a separate read on your character and judgment through lighter, more personal prompts.
rubric: Critical engagement with Anthropic's public commitments
